goal: Prevent malformed frontier result envelopes from being reprocessed forever by quarantining a generic ingest failure exactly once while preserving diagnostics and all existing success/replay semantics.
acceptance: A generic frontier_result ingest failure moves the original envelope out of active incoming processing into a deterministic error quarantine path.
Diagnostics are persisted separately from the quarantined envelope.
A second result_consumer invocation does not retry the same failed envelope.
Existing successful ingest behavior remains valid.
Existing replay return-code 2 behavior remains valid.
relay_daemon_check.py contains a regression scenario that fails on the pre-fix behavior and passes after the fix.
The builder and reviewer have no Git write or merge authority.
